high_level_description: The image is a promotional graphic for the video game "Skull and Bones." The top portion of the image features bold white text on a black background that reads: "Skull and Bones: The first made-in-Singapore major video game that took over 10 years to make." Below this text, there is a white rectangular box with a pink and purple logo on the left side, followed by the question "WORTH YOUR TIME?" in black text. The bottom portion of the image shows a vibrant and detailed scene from the game. It depicts three characters standing on a wooden platform overlooking a picturesque coastal landscape.
